description.value: Island Travel Inn is a budget-friendly downtown Victoria hotel on Douglas Street, steps from the Inner Harbour, Parliament Buildings, Royal BC Museum, and Fisherman's Wharf — making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city core. The property operates a 24/7 front desk and offers free covered on-site parking. It is also positioned near public transit connections to BC Ferries and regional attractions such as Butchart Gardens.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone, address, URL). The amenities page and about-us page are detailed: laundry ('coin-operated guest laundry facilities'), vending machines ('Vending machine - Drinks & Snacks'), and Wi-Fi ('Free High Speed Wi-Fi') are all explicitly confirmed. No bike-specific storage is mentioned anywhere on the site — the parking references ('free, secure, covered parking', 'Underground secured parking available') describe vehicle parking only, so bike storage remains null.
concerns: OSM tag 'building:levels=4' conflicts with the website About Us page which describes the property as a '3-story property'. Minor discrepancy; no action required.
Toll-free number 1-888-570-7939 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating downtown Victoria hotel with a live website, confirmed contact details, and active room listings. Useful stopover for touring cyclists in the city.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated guest laundry facilities on-site (confirmed on About Us page)

Vending machines.detail: Vending machine (drinks and snacks) listed on Hotel Amenities page
